        long q = Long.parseLong(tokens[3]);
        
        long range = q - p + 1;
        long oddCount, evenCount;

            oddCount = range / 2;
        } else {
            oddCount = range - range / 2;
            evenCount = range / 2;

        if (memo.containsKey(st)) return memo.get(st);

            long nch = compute(even, odd, half, 1, memoEven, memoOdd);
            if (type == 0) {
                result = (ch * ch % MOD + nch * nch % MOD) % MOD;
            } else {
                result = (2 * ch % MOD * nch % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        memo.put(st, result);
        return result;
    }

    private static long power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;

            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;

        return result;
